meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 DepMap 数据库,获取特定基因在癌症细胞系中的依赖分数、药物敏感性数据,并分析基因与癌症类型、突变状态的关系。
howto.when: 当用户询问某基因在特定癌症中是否必需、寻找合成致死伙伴,或分析药物敏感性的预测标志物时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数
找出与 TP53 共必需性最高的 20 个基因
say.note: Claude 会计算基因效应相关性并列出头部结果。

say.text: 分析 BRCA1 突变对 PARP1 依赖性的影响
say.note: Claude 会比较突变与野生型细胞系的基因效应差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the DepMap database to fetch gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles across cancer cell lines, and relate them to cancer type, mutation status, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask whether a gene is essential in a specific cancer, search for synthetic lethal partners, or analyze biomarkers predicting drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Check the dependency scores of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Claude returns Chronos scores and dependency calls for those lines.

say_en.text: Find the top 20 genes co-essential with TP53.
say_en.note: Claude computes gene-effect correlations and lists top hits.

say_en.text: Analyze how BRCA1 mutation affects PARP1 dependency.
say_en.note: Claude compares gene effects between mutated and wild-type lines.
